# boxbox_me (Data Source)

Who the provider's API token is, and the tenant's quota and usage (`GET me`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "boxbox_me" "me" {}

output "quota" {
  value = data.boxbox_me.me.quota
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (List of String) Images a machine can be created from.
- `quota` (Attributes) The tenant's quota; null when the tenant has none (then it cannot create machines) and for the owner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota))
- `role` (String) `tenant` or `admin`.
- `tenant` (String) Name of the tenant; null for the owner.
- `usage` (Attributes) What all machines in the tenant's pool add up to, whoever made them; null for the owner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))
- `user` (String) PVE user of the token, `<name>@pve`.

<a id="nestedatt--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota--cpu))
- `disk` (String) Disks in total, as asked for.
- `ha` (Boolean) Whether the tenant may ask for `ha.replicas`.
- `machines` (Number) Number of machines.
- `memory` (String) Memory in total.

<a id="nestedatt--quota--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota.cpu`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) Visible threads in total.
- `min` (Number) Guaranteed threads in total.



<a id="nestedatt--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage--cpu))
- `disk` (String)
- `machines` (Number)
- `memory` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--usage--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage.cpu`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) Visible threads in use.
- `min` (Number) Guaranteed threads in use.
